| Layer | Probe | Result |
|---|---|---|
| declared | `probe declared feature_x` | `enabled` |
| built | `probe built feature_x` | `enabled` (artifact `a19`) |
| runtime | `probe runtime feature_x` | `enabled` (artifact `a19`, self-reported) |
| applied (what the loader actually put in service) | `state/applied.conf` | artifact `a12` — not `a19` |

The runtime claims it loaded `a19` with `feature_x` enabled, but the loader's own record shows `a12` is what's actually in service. Per the system's semantics, `check` follows `applied`, so the self-report loses: the effective verdict is `inactive`. `machine/reality.yaml` agrees (`feature_x: inactive`). Nothing here is unobservable, so it's determinable rather than unknown.
